reviewed_scope.scope: Six r2 residuals and the archive locator/content-role additions. This is not an exhaustive re-review of all fields or an implementation acceptance.

prior_finding_resolutions.evidence: Global targets now use ordinary role-limited FKs. Mixed ModelAttempt rows require owner_id whenever turn_id is present; the composite owner FK remains. Mixed processing parents enforce public-or-same-owner compatibility.

FactAssertion now has subject_kind, subject_contract_id and subject_provider_id in addition to person_id. Kind-specific mutually exclusive subject constraints and predicate-kind matching preserve scalar identity.

Every relationship separates physical on_delete from orm_on_delete. Native Permission -> ContentType uses ORM CASCADE and explicitly preserves physical native NO ACTION pending catalog rehearsal; nullable admin content type uses ORM SET_NULL.

Both ContentCopy endpoints use same_scope_owner and owner IS NOT DISTINCT FROM source owner; private copy rows cannot point to public artifacts. Dependent output scope and containment are also explicit.

source_assertion_id and import_grant_id are required for authorized_import, with exact grant membership/conversation checks. Supersession is restricted to the destination conversation in dictionary constraints and r3 clarification.

ProviderObservation.insurer_id is optional for insurer-independent wheelchair accessibility, while insurer-specific network/exclusion/authorization kinds require it. Configuration must match its insurer.

evidence: LegacyMapping.archive_blob_id is a required FK to OriginalBlob using exact same-scope ownership. Its validation requires legacy_record_archive and the source record fingerprint.

Acquisition requires acquired_original and matching source scope; ProcessingJob.result_blob_id requires processing_derivative and matching scope. DocumentRevision excludes archive/derivative roles from contractual truth and the independent original denominator.
Erased source payloads cannot be reimported; archive is a retained source payload locator, not translated insurer knowledge.
implementation_limits: Native archive hash serialization and actual preservation/erasure must be rehearsed only after design approval.
The acquired_original default does not replace acquisition/provenance and content-role validation; archivers and derivative writers must satisfy the explicit role constraints.

findings.issue: Earlier conversation-lineage prose still allows supersession across conversations under an authorized import. The r3 dictionary and later clarification correctly use source_assertion_id for import and keep supersedes within the destination.
findings.fix: Remove the obsolete unless-an-authorized-import exception from the supersession paragraph; preserve the separate import lineage description.
findings.effect: Documentation consistency cleanup; the revised dictionary already expresses the intended rule.

checks.reason_no_repeated_json_probes: The r3 delta changes dictionary and relationship declarations; the JSON contract schema remains r2 and its previously focused probes remain scoped evidence, not database runtime verification.

pending_next_revision.requirements: Required document identity and immutable original hash; PDF page optional only for non-PDF kinds; strict PDF-region/HTML-element/JSON-pointer/text-range locator; preserve actual source media and method without inventing a PDF page.

Verify the existing preference fields and ownership against the source inventory, then represent the selected route and timestamp without inferring successful qualification or resetting user preference.

approval_boundary: All six r2 residuals are addressed in the proposal. Database design still requires the user discussion/approval; full scenario/evidence completeness and the announced next changes are not certified here.
verification_limit: Read-only JSON/document inspection and structural assertions only. No Django setup, native database catalog, migrations, constraints, RLS, workers or customer data were executed/read.
